verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's rules docs say rules can be scoped, ramped, and scheduled. Release plans let a value-serving rule ramp up automatically over time, and "Ramp schedules" appear as a paid-tier feature on the pricing page. The evidence shows scheduling exists but says little about how it works: it describes automatic ramping more than a one-off change that fires at a specific date and time. missing for 10: explicit documentation of setting a specific future date/time for a flag change or release, details of the scheduling UI/API and plan availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time
